why_desktop: the stick carries Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS, which the kit offers with GNOME only; the job writer refuses any other desktop on that stick (Fedora and Ubuntu in parallel, the owner, 2026-11-13)
stick: filled through the window (UPGRADE.exe) with Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS picked, before kickoff
why_this_order: most likely in the wild first (the owner, 2026-10-27); state forces the rollback before the erase and the refusal after the walk-away
why_no_stage_0: the 2026-10-11 install was already rolled back on 2026-10-12 (Windows side; rollback.json on the stick) and its settle-in predates 'settle-in rollback': the old Fedora is cleared by hand before the run (the owner, 2026-10-28), so the run starts at the look
why_test_password: the owner, 2026-10-28: the test account's password is 'password' on a test machine, so the owner can sign in at the screen
why_test_autologon: the owner, 2026-10-28 and 2026-10-31: signing in by hand after each restart is not one click; the test signs Windows in by itself (the password as Windows' own LSA secret), says so in every row, and switches it off when the run finishes. Windows' account has the test password since the walk-away of 2026-10-29; a fresh walk-away account gets it at its first sign-in
why_data_loss: the Aspire's scan is RED (its dying drive, R23): every stage that writes a job names the sentence, so the owner types it at kickoff, never added in silence

stages.why: the default path: install beside Windows, settle-in's first start, both systems start
people forget the stick: it must not install again

stages.owner_step: Take the kit stick out of the Aspire and put the walk-away stick in (both are serial-less General UDisks: with both in, the walk-away rightly refuses both).
stages.why: back to a fresh Windows after a clean slate; the test keeps Linux awake through the prepare (the owner, 2026-10-28: KDE slept 45 minutes in, settle-in holds no lock)

stages.owner_step: Take the walk-away stick out (it starts Windows Setup) and put the kit stick back in.

why_retry: a stage that stops is tried again in the same run (oneclick.py retry), with the approvals typed at kickoff; the tail plan of 2026-10-28 that did this by hand is gone (its copy is in its run folder's run.json)
why_no_cancel: the owner, 2026-11-02: the last click in the window is the commit line; no countdown and no cancel after it, so the cancel stage (V9 arm B) is gone
